info.title: Shept server
info.description: Secure private self-hosted end-to-end encryption messaging server.

get.description: Returns a one-time value the client embeds in the RSA-signed login JWT. Every challenge is accepted once.

put.description: Moves the caller's read cursor of a conversation and tells the other participant. Only the instant is stored: the server never learns which message was opened, and a client that keeps receipts off never calls this. Idempotent, and it never moves backwards.

parameters.name: peerId
parameters.description: The other participant of the conversation

schema.description: The other participant of the conversation

post.description: Uploads an end-to-end encrypted media file bound to the receiver. The server stores only the ciphertext. Returns the media id.

file.description: The encrypted media blob (nonce || mac || ciphertext). Its field name must be file.

receiverId.description: Id of the user the media is sent to.

post.description: Starts a resumable upload of an end-to-end encrypted media file bound to the receiver. Returns the upload id and the offset the server holds.

200.description: The upload session, with the offset the server holds.

get.description: Returns how much of the encrypted media file the server holds, so a client can resume a broken upload.

200.description: The upload session, with the offset the server holds.

put.description: Appends one chunk of the encrypted media file at the Upload-Offset header. A chunk at a different offset is refused with 409 and the offset the server holds.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Byte offset this chunk starts at; must equal the received count.

chunk.description: One slice of the encrypted media blob. Its field name must be chunk.

200.description: The upload session, with the new offset.

post.description: Turns a fully received chunked upload into a media file the receiver can download. Only the sender may complete it, and only once every byte is in.

200.description: The media file is complete and downloadable.

get.summary: Download encrypted media file by id
get.description: Downloads the encrypted media file. Only the intended receiver may download it. The file is retained until the client confirms the download or its TTL expires.

delete.summary: Confirm media download and delete it
delete.description: Confirms the encrypted media file has been downloaded and deletes it from the server. Only the intended receiver may confirm. Idempotent.

get.description: One page of a conversation from the ciphertext archive, newest first. The server never sees the plaintext.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

schema.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

parameters.name: peerId
parameters.description: The other participant of the conversation

schema.description: The other participant of the conversation

delete.description: Deletes a conversation for the calling account on every device: everything sent at or before the cut stops being visible to it. The other participant keeps the archive. Idempotent.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: RFC3339 instant to delete up to (default: now)

schema.description: RFC3339 instant to delete up to (default: now)

parameters.name: peerId
parameters.description: The other participant of the conversation

schema.description: The other participant of the conversation

delete.description: Erases the ciphertext of a message the caller sent, unpins it and logs the tombstone, so both sides learn about it. Idempotent.

patch.description: Replaces the ciphertext of a message the caller sent with a new version and stamps the edit. Both sides learn about it through sync and a live edit frame. The server never sees the plaintext.

post.description: Removes one message from the calling account on every device. The other participant keeps it. Idempotent.

Records that the receiver opened a view-once attachment and tells both participants through sync and a live open frame, so the message stays in the conversation as a tombstone. The view-once flag itself lives inside the ciphertext, so this is a client-reported state. Only the receiver may call it. Idempotent.

put.description: Pins a message of the chat for both participants. Anyone in the conversation may pin. Idempotent.

delete.description: Removes a pin for both participants. Idempotent.

put.description: Stores the caller's encrypted reaction on a message. A later reaction replaces it; both sides learn about it through sync and a live reaction frame.

delete.description: Clears the caller's reaction on a message. Idempotent.

get.summary: Get all users except the user

get.description: Lists the devices signed into the account. The requesting device is flagged.

post.description: Locks a device out immediately: it cannot log in, renew its token, call the API or keep its WebSocket.
Lets a revoked device sign in again. Only a live device of the same account may do this.

get.description: Returns how long the server keeps the ciphertext archive of this account.

put.description: The shorter retention of both participants wins, because both accounts can read a message.

get.description: Returns the server build, the API version and the oldest client it accepts.

readAt.description: Instant up to which the chat was read
